claims.assertion: Yazhi says physical and nonphysical experience are perceptions within one mental existential realm.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She calls suffering illusory while saying people can still avoid harm.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says directly fighting the Cabal feeds it; she favors offering people alternatives instead.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says defeating it could impose one's views and create a new Cabal.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says starseeds incarnate to model alternatives and take on a difficult challenge for personal growth.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says the Earth's increased difficulty motivated larger waves of advanced souls.
